errors.text: The proposed Mo addition does not reconstruct the demonstrated processing-plus-silicide-coating intervention.
Neither cited source supports the claim that Mo produces a stable protective oxide on equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr; the cited Mo study addresses mechanical properties rather than oxidation.
The mechanism ignores the volatility and potential nonprotective behavior of Mo oxides at elevated temperature.
The experiment does not test whether useful room- or high-temperature mechanical performance is preserved after alloying and oxidation.
